description:
CygNet / VBScript Developer 
 
 
 - On behalf of our client in the Oil and Gas sector Procom Services is looking for one Developer with strong CygNet and VB scripting skills. The successful candidate will have experience working with VBScript linking various host applications including SCADA. 

 

 CygNet / VBScript Developer Job Details 
 

 Develop New CygNet SCADA Scripts
 Update/Enhance existing CygNet SCADA Scripts
 Test CygNet SCADA Scripts
 Test .NET Applications/messaging queues for interfacing with CygNet SCADA
 Monitor existing applications and scripts as needed
 Production support of applications and scripts as needed
 Update documentation as required for all new and updated applications and scripts
  
 CygNet / VBScript Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 

 Experience in CygNet SCADA development/Cygnet Studio environment
 Minimum of 5 years VBScripting
 Visual Basic, Windows COM, XML, and CygNet SCADA scripting experience
 Basic ability to understand and write SQL
  
 CygNet / VBScript Developer Nice to Have Skills 
 

 Advanced SQL or C# programming
 Experience in remote monitoring/controlling systems.
 Experience within pipeline applications.
  
  CygNet / VBScript Developer Start Date 
 

  March, 2016
 

 

 CygNet / VBScript Developer Assignment Length 
 

  12 month's plus


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
